text: A Bureau patrol went missing near the old sewers. They were carrying Engine schematics.
The Bureau has lifted quarantine on the eastern district. It's safe to pass through.
A high-ranking Bureau agent has been selling quarantine codes to smugglers.
The Bureau is recruiting outsiders for an emergency Engine repair team. Good pay, high risk.
Someone torched the Bureau's evidence ledger the night before the audit.
A new curfew bell rings at dusk. The Bureau says it is for everyone's safety.
The Bureau is offering amnesty to anyone who surrenders bloom-touched kin. No questions asked.
An inspector from the capital arrived in a sealed carriage. No one has seen them since.
